note_boss: LIBER I HAS NO BOSS (CURRICULUM §2 gives a probātiō only to L2, L6 and later). The manifest entry must therefore carry no "boss" field, or a null one — js/app.js only pushes a boss node when the region object declares one, and content/historia-l1.js declares none. server/lib/rules.php needs an 'l1' entry with 'fables' => array('h1','h2','h3','h4','h5'), 'track' => 'historia', NO 'boss', and an EMPTY 'quiz' array (api/boss_quiz.php reports an empty key as 'not available', which is the correct behaviour for a region that has no trial).
note_progress: progressId is 'l1' — the content id doubles as the key, as r02 does. Nothing pre-existing uses it, so no rule_region_aliases() entry is needed.
note_track: This is the FIRST region of the 'historia' track. Its manifest "regions" array is currently empty, so adding l1 also turns the Historia door from the MOX screen into a live map (js/app.js firstRegionId).
